exact_original_statement: Prove existence of absolutely continuous spectrum (delocalised states) for the random Schrodinger operator -Delta + lambda V on Z^3 at small disorder lambda, and GOE local statistics for its finite-volume restriction.
formal_spectral_subtarget: For iid uniform [-sqrt(3),sqrt(3)] sites on Z^3, find lambda_0>0 and a nonempty deterministic open I subset (-6,6) so that for each fixed 0<lambda<lambda_0 the ac part of H_lambda on I is almost surely nonzero. Probability-one events may depend on lambda.
goe_scope: Separate periodic-box bulk limit at volume/DOS scale; not proved in this lane. The historical source gives a qualitative goal, not full energy/DOS quantifiers.
